description: Django models defining data structures for recipes, ingredients, categories, and related entities in a recipe management backend.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A category under which recipes can be grouped, e.g., 'Dessert', 'Main Course'.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: An ingredient that can be used in recipes, with a name and description.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a cooking recipe created by a user, including fields for title, description, instructions, cook time, user, categories, and ingredients.

classes.name: RecipeIngredient
classes.description: Through-model linking Recipe and Ingredient, storing quantity and unit.

classes.name: FavoriteRecipe
classes.description: A user's favorite recipe, allowing bookmarking.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, typically its name or title.
